from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_modes = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    col_modes = [Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0] for c in range(w)]
    row_mode_counts = Counter(row_modes)
    col_mode_counts = Counter(col_modes)
    row_line = min(row_mode_counts, key=row_mode_counts.get)
    col_line = min(col_mode_counts, key=col_mode_counts.get)
    rows = [r for r, v in enumerate(row_modes) if v == row_line]
    cols = [c for c, v in enumerate(col_modes) if v == col_line]
    active_rows = [r for r in rows if any(grid[r][c] != row_line for c in cols)]
    active_cols = [c for c in cols if any(grid[r][c] != col_line for r in rows)]
    rows = [r for r in rows if active_rows[0] <= r <= active_rows[-1]]
    cols = [c for c in cols if active_cols[0] <= c <= active_cols[-1]]
    inside = min(Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[0]
    out = []
    for r in range(len(rows)-1):
        line = []
        for c in range(len(cols)-1):
            corners = [grid[rows[r]][cols[c]], grid[rows[r]][cols[c+1]],
                       grid[rows[r+1]][cols[c]], grid[rows[r+1]][cols[c+1]]]
            line.append(corners[0] if corners[0] != row_line and all(x == corners[0] for x in corners) else inside)
        out.append(line)
    return out

def make_grid(h,w,bg,line,rs,cs,verts):
    g=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in rs:
        for c in range(w):g[r][c]=line
    for c in cs:
        for r in range(h):g[r][c]=line
    for i,r in enumerate(rs):
        for j,c in enumerate(cs):g[r][c]=verts[i][j]
